Pricing

View pricing details for our studio, 1, 2, & 3-bedroom apartments in Isla Vista, CA near UC Santa Barbara today!
PRICE LISTED IS PER BED

For clarity and transparency, we’ve outlined the fees you may encounter as a resident below. Some charges are required as part of your lease agreement, while others are optional or situational, based on your preferences and usage. If you have any questions about how these fees apply to you, our team is always happy to help.

View Fees

Studio Apartments
Our studio apartments feature 450 square feet and a 1-bathroom layout designed for streamlined student living. These efficient spaces are available in single- and double-occupancy options, giving residents flexibility in their preferred living setup while maintaining a simple, functional apartment design.

One-Bedroom Apartments
Our one-bedroom apartments feature 517 square feet and a 1-bathroom layout, creating a practical living space designed for comfort and convenience. These homes provide a more defined apartment setup with functional interiors suited for everyday student living.

Two-Bedroom Apartments
Our two-bedroom apartments range from 517 to 1,285 square feet, with 1- and 2-bathroom configurations, accommodating a variety of shared living arrangements. With single-, double-, and triple-occupancy options available across select layouts, these homes offer flexibility for different roommate setups and lifestyle needs.

Three-Bedroom Apartments
Our three-bedroom apartments range from 1,000 to 1,550 square feet, with 2-bathroom layouts, offering flexible shared living options for larger roommate groups. Multiple-occupancy configurations make these homes ideal for residents who want a connected student living setup with both private and shared bedroom options.
